model_annotation: This chart presents a grouped bar chart comparing performance metrics across multiple categories (whose labels along the horizontal axis are partially obscured or cut off) for six model variants: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (red), as indicated by the legend in the upper right. The vertical axis appears to represent a numerical scale with horizontal gridlines, though the axis labels and tick marks on the left side are partially obscured; the scale appears to range from approximately 0 to a value near the top of the chart. Each category along the horizontal axis contains a cluster of six bars corresponding to the six model variants, and each bar is accompanied by black error bars indicating variability or confidence intervals. Across the visible groups, the bars vary considerably in height: in some groups (such as the second and fourth from the left), the bars reach relatively tall heights with values near the upper portion of the scale, while in other groups (particularly toward the right side of the chart), the bars are notably shorter, approaching near-zero values. The error bars also vary substantially, with some extending quite far above and below the bar tops, particularly for the shorter bars on the right side of the chart, where the error bars appear disproportionately large relative to bar height. The bars do not appear to follow a consistent sorting order within each group, but rather maintain the same left-to-right arrangement of the six model variants across all categories. No bars appear to be visually emphasized beyond their color coding, and the grouping structure consistently places the L₂ variants (blue shades) first, followed by R₂ variants (green shades), and then B₂ variants (pink/red shades) within each cluster.
